name: bamboohr-openapi
description: An unofficial OpenAPI definition of the BambooHR API.
author: Kevin Locke <kevin@kevinlocke.name>
//: All scripts should run in POSIX sh and Windows cmd.exe

scripts.postpublish: git -C doc push && git push --follow-tags origin main gh-pages && echo Remember to update GitHub Releases from CHANGELOG.md
scripts.postversion: rimraf doc && git clone -b gh-pages -l -q . doc && npm run doc && git -C doc add . && git -C doc commit -n -m "Docs for v$npm_package_version"
scripts.preversion: depcheck --ignore-dirs doc --ignores="bootprint-openapi,eslint-*,rimraf" && david && git-branch-is main && hub-ci-status -vv --wait
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run validate
scripts.validate: npm run validate-autorest && npm run validate-openapi-generator && npm run validate-spectral
scripts.version: sed -i.bak "1,20s/^\(  version:\) 0\.[0-9.]*$/\1 $npm_package_version/" openapi.yaml && rm openapi.yaml.bak && github_changelog_generator -t "$npm_config_gcg_github_token" --future-release "$npm_package_version" && echo && echo === Please edit CHANGELOG.md as desired, then exit === && echo && $npm_config_shell && git commit -m "Update CHANGELOG.md for $npm_package_version" CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "Update OpenAPI spec version to $npm_package_version" openapi.yaml
scripts.version-deps: npm install david depcheck git-branch-is hub-ci-status

david.//: ESLint packages must be updated together.  Only warn about @kevinoid/eslint-config
